title: Proposal
subtitle: A premium, customer-ready presentation of your project.

empty.title: Nothing to present yet
empty.body: Approve the Scope of Work and this proposal fills itself in.

awaitingApproval: The Scope of Work isn't approved yet. Approve it to complete this proposal.

investment.note: Final pricing is confirmed before any work begins.

pricing.ballparkBody: This preliminary range uses the saved Ballpark estimate. Detailed work retained on this estimate is not included in the active price shown here.
pricing.incompleteBody: This partial detailed total is not a final customer price. Complete pricing for the current scope before accepting or printing this proposal.

upgrades.note: Optional — add any of these at any time.

settings.title: Proposal settings
settings.brandHint: Leave blank to use your organization name. Only affects this project's proposal.
settings.asIllustratedHint: Buyer/realtor proposals show the overall range plus this single As Illustrated figure. Leave blank to derive it from the project's finish signals. It is always kept inside the Low–High range.
settings.pricingDisclosureHint: You decide how much pricing detail the client sees. This never changes the estimate.

contractorOnly: Contractor preview only — the customer never sees this panel.

validity.heading: Validity
validity.body: This estimate is valid for {{days}} days from the date shown. After that, pricing and availability may be re-quoted.

basisOfEstimate.heading: Basis of estimate
basisOfEstimate.body: Scope and pricing are based on the information, measurements, photos and selections known at the time this estimate was prepared.

concealedConditions.heading: Concealed or unforeseen conditions
concealedConditions.body: Conditions that are not visible or reasonably knowable before work begins — such as hidden damage, rot, mold, or non-conforming existing work — may require a written change order before that work proceeds.

permitsAndCode.heading: Permits, code and engineering
permitsAndCode.body: Permit requirements, code compliance and any engineering or structural review are subject to final verification with the authority having jurisdiction and may affect scope, schedule and price.

selectionsAndAllowances.heading: Selections and allowances
selectionsAndAllowances.body: Where materials, fixtures or finishes are shown as allowances or are not yet selected, final pricing is confirmed once documented selections are made.

preliminaryVsFinal.heading: Preliminary estimate
preliminaryVsFinal.body: This document is a preliminary estimate, not a final detailed proposal. A confirmed price follows a site visit, verified measurements and contractor review.

acceptance.heading: Acceptance
acceptance.body: Typing your name and accepting indicates your approval of the scope and price shown. Work is scheduled after acceptance and any required agreement or deposit.

changeOrders.heading: Change orders
changeOrders.body: Any change to the scope, materials, selections or site conditions described here is handled through a written change order signed by both parties before the affected work proceeds.

exclusions.heading: Exclusions
exclusions.body: Anything not expressly listed in the scope of work is excluded. Common exclusions include hazardous material abatement, structural upgrades not identified here, landscaping restoration and utility relocation unless stated otherwise.

taxesAndFees.heading: Taxes and fees
taxesAndFees.body: Applicable sales tax, permit fees, disposal fees and third-party inspection fees are shown separately where known and are added at invoicing where they are not.

template.internalBadge: Internal use only — do not present to a buyer as a final construction proposal or guaranteed price.

contractor.label: Contractor / Homeowner Proposal
contractor.description: The standard construction proposal: scope, investment options, schedule, warranty and acceptance.

buyer_transformation.label: Property Transformation Proposal — Buyer Facing
buyer_transformation.description: Aspirational, buyer-facing visualization package: existing condition, conceptual transformation and preliminary renovation context.

realtor_brief.label: Property Opportunity Brief — Realtor Internal
realtor_brief.description: Internal agent brief: buyer objections, transformation opportunities, preliminary cost context and positioning notes.

print.error: Unable to open proposal for printing. Please try again.

asIllustrated.note: Based on the project concept illustrated in this proposal, assuming attractive builder-grade standard finishes. This is a planning estimate, not a contract price — final pricing will depend on confirmed scope, material and finish selections, site conditions, engineering requirements, and other project-specific details.
asIllustrated.assumed: Finish level could not be confirmed from the project data, so this figure assumes a clean, builder-grade standard finish package — not a luxury or custom package. Your contractor can refine it before presenting.

send.title: Email proposal to client
send.subject: Subject
send.defaultMessage: Hi {{name}}, here is the proposal for {{project}}. You can review everything and request changes from the secure link below.
send.emailNotConfigured: Automatic email delivery is not set up for this workspace yet, so the link opens in your own email app. The link itself is live, secure and revocable.

error.recipient: Enter a valid client email address.
error.project: This project has no proposal to send yet.
error.save: The proposal version could not be saved. Nothing was sent.
error.network: No connection. The proposal was not sent.
error.copy: Could not copy the link. Select and copy it manually.

client.title: Client access & requests
client.applyHint: Applying records your decision and leaves every sent version untouched. Update the proposal, then send a new version.

portal.requestHint: Tell your contractor what you would like to change. Your contractor reviews every request before anything is updated.
portal.message: What would you like to change?
portal.messagePlaceholder: For example: can we price an acrylic surround instead of the tile shower?
portal.messageRequired: Please describe the change you would like.
portal.submittedBody: Your contractor has been notified and will follow up with a revised proposal if the change is accepted.
portal.submitError: The request could not be sent. Please try again.
portal.readOnlyNote: This is a read-only copy of the proposal your contractor sent. Pricing and scope can only be changed by your contractor.
portal.notFound: This proposal link is not valid.
portal.revoked: This proposal link has been turned off by your contractor.
portal.contactContractor: Please contact your contractor for an updated link.
